input.task: What is the UPC product code of this lamp?

provenance: found by live-books-detail-upc on its first run (M6): `{role: cell, near: 'UPC'}` returned the string 'UPC' — the label cell itself. A scope-less `<th>` computes as role `cell` in Chromium, so the anchor's own element was in the candidate set at distance zero and won every time. `near` means beside, not is: the anchor element and anything containing it are the one relation proximity must never return. This fixture is the offline twin, because live cases never gate a commit (eval-protocol) and the fast suite had no label/value table at all.

triage.what_this_grades: that the answer is the VALUE, not the label. The failure mode has no error in it — the run succeeded, the identity anchor was on the page, the tier was recorded as `structural`, and the reported answer was the question restated. Only ground truth catches it, which is why the value here is a 16-hex-digit code no run can reach by accident.
triage.watched_red: before the fix: status success, answer 'UPC'.
